what: Proposed raw ^- bullet counting does not exclude fenced diagnostics
scenario_or_breakage: Existing run-log append-failure entries include fenced tool output; if that output contains a line like "- failed check", the final report counts it as a second issue instead of one logged failure
suggested_fix: Use one small shared bullet-count helper that tracks Markdown fences and counts ^- only outside fenced blocks; apply it to execution-issues.md, structured NDJSON bodies, and body_text fallback.
